type progressionTaskProviderStub struct {
	tasks          map[string]*TaskMetadata
	structure      *CourseStructure
	structureCalls *int
}

func (s progressionTaskProviderStub) GetTask(_ context.Context, taskID string) (*TaskMetadata, error) {
	task, ok := s.tasks[taskID]
	if !ok {
		return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	return task, nil
}

func (s progressionTaskProviderStub) GetCourseStructure(_ context.Context, courseID string) (*CourseStructure, error) {
	if s.structureCalls != nil {
		*s.structureCalls++
	}
	if s.structure == nil || s.structure.CourseID != courseID {
		return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	return s.structure, nil
}

type progressionLessonProviderStub struct {
	lessons map[string]*LessonMetadata
}

func (s progressionLessonProviderStub) GetLesson(_ context.Context, lessonID string) (*LessonMetadata, error) {
	lesson, ok := s.lessons[lessonID]
	if !ok {
		return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	return lesson, nil
}

	return nil, nil

func TestProgressionServiceResolveCourseSequentialUnlock(t *testing.T) {
	service := ProgressionService{
		TaskProvider: progressionTaskProviderStub{
			structure: &CourseStructure{
				CourseID: "cv-1",
				Lessons: []CourseStructureLesson{
					{
						ID:     "lesson-1",
						Order:  1,
						Status: 1,
						Tasks: []CourseStructureTask{{
							ID: "task-1", LessonID: "lesson-1", CourseID: "cv-1", Order: 1, Status: 1, EvaluationMode: "AUTO",
						}},
					},
					{
						ID:     "lesson-2",
						Order:  2,
						Status: 1,
						Tasks: []CourseStructureTask{{
							ID: "task-2", LessonID: "lesson-2", CourseID: "cv-1", Order: 1, Status: 1, EvaluationMode: "AUTO",
						}},
					},
				},
			},
		},
		Answers: progressionAnswerRepoStub{progress: map[string]domain.StudentTaskProgress{}},
	}

	result, err := service.ResolveCourse(context.Background(), "user-1", "cv-1")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected error: %v", err)
	}
	if result.CurrentTaskID != "task-1" {
		t.Fatalf("expected current task task-1, got %q", result.CurrentTaskID)
	}
	if len(result.Lessons) != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("expected 2 lessons, got %d", len(result.Lessons))
	}
	if result.Lessons[0].Tasks[0].Locked {
		t.Fatalf("expected first task to be unlocked")
	}
	if !result.Lessons[0].Tasks[0].Current {
		t.Fatalf("expected first task to be current")
	}
	if !result.Lessons[1].Tasks[0].Locked {
		t.Fatalf("expected second task to be locked")
	}
}

func TestProgressionServicePreservesCourseStructureLessonOrder(t *testing.T) {
	service := ProgressionService{
		TaskProvider: progressionTaskProviderStub{
			structure: &CourseStructure{
				CourseID: "course-1",
				Lessons: []CourseStructureLesson{
					{
						ID: "lesson-z", Order: 1, Status: 1,
						Tasks: []CourseStructureTask{{
							ID: "task-z", LessonID: "lesson-z", CourseID: "course-1", Order: 1, Status: 1, EvaluationMode: "AUTO",
						}},
					},
					{
						ID: "lesson-a", Order: 1, Status: 1,
						Tasks: []CourseStructureTask{{
							ID: "task-a", LessonID: "lesson-a", CourseID: "course-1", Order: 1, Status: 1, EvaluationMode: "AUTO",
						}},
					},
				},
			},
		},
		Answers: progressionAnswerRepoStub{progress: map[string]domain.StudentTaskProgress{}},
	}

	result, err := service.ResolveCourse(context.Background(), "user-1", "course-1")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected error: %v", err)
	}
	if len(result.Lessons) != 2 || result.Lessons[0].ID != "lesson-z" || result.Lessons[1].ID != "lesson-a" {
		t.Fatalf("lesson order = %#v, want provider hierarchy order [lesson-z lesson-a]", result.Lessons)
	}
	if result.CurrentTaskID != "task-z" {
		t.Fatalf("current task = %q, want task-z", result.CurrentTaskID)
	}
	if !result.Lessons[1].Tasks[0].Locked {
		t.Fatalf("second hierarchy lesson task must remain locked")
	}
}

func TestProgressionServiceResolveCourseUnlocksNextAfterPassed(t *testing.T) {
	service := ProgressionService{
		TaskProvider: progressionTaskProviderStub{
			structure: &CourseStructure{
				CourseID: "cv-1",
				Lessons: []CourseStructureLesson{
					{
						ID:     "lesson-1",
						Order:  1,
						Status: 1,
						Tasks: []CourseStructureTask{{
							ID: "task-1", LessonID: "lesson-1", CourseID: "cv-1", Order: 1, Status: 1, EvaluationMode: "AUTO",
						}},
					},
					{
						ID:     "lesson-2",
						Order:  2,
						Status: 1,
						Tasks: []CourseStructureTask{{
							ID: "task-2", LessonID: "lesson-2", CourseID: "cv-1", Order: 1, Status: 1, EvaluationMode: "AUTO",
						}},
					},
				},
			},
		},
		Answers: progressionAnswerRepoStub{progress: map[string]domain.StudentTaskProgress{
			"task-1": {
				TaskID:         "task-1",
				HasPassed:      true,
				LatestStatus:   domain.StudentTaskAnswerStatusPassed,
				LatestAnswerID: "answer-1",
			},
		}},
	}

	result, err := service.ResolveCourse(context.Background(), "user-1", "cv-1")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected error: %v", err)
	}
	if !result.Lessons[0].Completed {
		t.Fatalf("expected first lesson to be completed")
	}
	if result.CurrentTaskID != "task-2" {
		t.Fatalf("expected current task task-2, got %q", result.CurrentTaskID)
	}
	if result.Lessons[1].Tasks[0].Locked {
		t.Fatalf("expected second task to be unlocked")
	}
}

func TestProgressionServiceResolveCourseTreatsUnderReviewAsCompletedForManual(t *testing.T) {
	service := ProgressionService{
		TaskProvider: progressionTaskProviderStub{
			structure: &CourseStructure{
				CourseID: "cv-1",
				Lessons: []CourseStructureLesson{
					{
						ID:     "lesson-1",
						Order:  1,
						Status: 1,
						Tasks: []CourseStructureTask{{
							ID: "task-1", LessonID: "lesson-1", CourseID: "cv-1", Order: 1, Status: 1, EvaluationMode: "MANUAL",
						}},
					},
					{
						ID:     "lesson-2",
						Order:  2,
						Status: 1,
						Tasks: []CourseStructureTask{{
							ID: "task-2", LessonID: "lesson-2", CourseID: "cv-1", Order: 1, Status: 1, EvaluationMode: "AUTO",
						}},
					},
				},
			},
		},
		Answers: progressionAnswerRepoStub{progress: map[string]domain.StudentTaskProgress{
			"task-1": {
				TaskID:         "task-1",
				HasUnderReview: true,
				LatestStatus:   domain.StudentTaskAnswerStatusUnderReview,
				LatestAnswerID: "answer-1",
			},
		}},
	}

	result, err := service.ResolveCourse(context.Background(), "user-1", "cv-1")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected error: %v", err)
	}
	if result.CurrentTaskID != "task-2" {
		t.Fatalf("expected second task to unlock after under review, got %q", result.CurrentTaskID)
	}
}

func TestProgressionServiceAllowsVerifiedRelatedTaskWithoutHiddenCourseProgression(t *testing.T) {
	structureCalls := 0
	service := ProgressionService{
		TaskProvider: progressionTaskProviderStub{
			tasks: map[string]*TaskMetadata{
				"task-related": {
					ID:             "task-related",
					LessonID:       "lesson-hidden",
					CourseID:       "course-hidden",
					Status:         domain.TaskStatusActive,
					EvaluationMode: taskEvaluationAuto,
				},
			},
			structureCalls: &structureCalls,
		},
		Answers: progressionAnswerRepoStub{progress: map[string]domain.StudentTaskProgress{}},
	}
	ctx := WithPublicContentAccess(context.Background(), "7f8b2498-4666-4ff2-8527-b5991199ca22")

	access, err := service.ResolveTaskAccess(ctx, "user-1", "task-related")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("resolve related task access: %v", err)
	}
	if access.Locked || !access.Current || access.CourseID != "course-hidden" {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected related task access: %+v", access)
	}
	if structureCalls != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("related task attempted to load hidden course progression %d times", structureCalls)
	}
}

func TestProgressionServiceAllowsVerifiedRelatedLessonWithoutHiddenCourseProgression(t *testing.T) {
	structureCalls := 0
	service := ProgressionService{
		TaskProvider: progressionTaskProviderStub{structureCalls: &structureCalls},
		Lessons: progressionLessonProviderStub{lessons: map[string]*LessonMetadata{
			"lesson-related": {
				ID:       "lesson-related",
				CourseID: "course-hidden",
				Status:   courseContentStatusActive,
			},
		}},
	}
	ctx := WithPublicContentAccess(context.Background(), "7f8b2498-4666-4ff2-8527-b5991199ca22")

	access, err := service.ResolveLessonAccess(ctx, "user-1", "lesson-related")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("resolve related lesson access: %v", err)
	}
	if access.Locked || !access.Current || access.CourseID != "course-hidden" {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected related lesson access: %+v", access)
	}
	if structureCalls != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("related lesson attempted to load hidden course progression %d times", structureCalls)
	}
}

func TestStartTaskAnswerBlocksLockedTask(t *testing.T) {
	provider := progressionTaskProviderStub{
		tasks: map[string]*TaskMetadata{
			"task-2": {
				ID:       "task-2",
				LessonID: "lesson-2",
				CourseID: "cv-1",
				Status:   domain.TaskStatusActive,
				Type:     1,
			},
		},
		structure: &CourseStructure{
			CourseID: "cv-1",
			Lessons: []CourseStructureLesson{
				{
					ID:     "lesson-1",
					Order:  1,
					Status: 1,
					Tasks: []CourseStructureTask{{
						ID: "task-1", LessonID: "lesson-1", CourseID: "cv-1", Order: 1, Status: 1, EvaluationMode: "AUTO",
					}},
				},
				{
					ID:     "lesson-2",
					Order:  2,
					Status: 1,
					Tasks: []CourseStructureTask{{
						ID: "task-2", LessonID: "lesson-2", CourseID: "cv-1", Order: 1, Status: 1, EvaluationMode: "AUTO",
					}},
				},
			},
		},
	}

	uc := StartTaskAnswer{
		TaskProvider: provider,
		Answers:      progressionAnswerRepoStub{progress: map[string]domain.StudentTaskProgress{}},
		Progression:  &ProgressionService{TaskProvider: provider, Answers: progressionAnswerRepoStub{progress: map[string]domain.StudentTaskProgress{}}},
	}

	_, err := uc.Handle(context.Background(), StartTaskAnswerInput{StudentID: "user-1", TaskID: "task-2"})
	if err == nil {
		t.Fatalf("expected locked task error")
	}
	var lockedErr *TaskLockedError
	if !errors.As(err, &lockedErr) {
		t.Fatalf("expected TaskLockedError, got %T", err)
	}
	if lockedErr.RedirectTaskID != "task-1" {
		t.Fatalf("expected redirect to task-1, got %q", lockedErr.RedirectTaskID)
	}
}

type taskAnswerGuardRepoStub struct {
	answers  map[string]*domain.StudentTaskAnswer
	progress map[string]domain.StudentTaskProgress
	updated  bool
}

func (s *taskAnswerGuardRepoStub) Create(context.Context, domain.StudentTaskAnswer, *int) (domain.StudentTaskAnswer, error) {
	return domain.StudentTaskAnswer{}, domain.ErrValidation
}

func (s *taskAnswerGuardRepoStub) Update(_ context.Context, answer domain.StudentTaskAnswer) error {
	s.updated = true
	copy := answer
	s.answers[answer.ID] = &copy
	return nil
}

func (s *taskAnswerGuardRepoStub) GetByID(_ context.Context, id string) (*domain.StudentTaskAnswer, error) {
	answer, ok := s.answers[id]
	if !ok {
		return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	copy := *answer
	return &copy, nil
}

func (s *taskAnswerGuardRepoStub) GetActiveForTaskAndStudent(context.Context, string, string) (*domain.StudentTaskAnswer, error) {
	return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
}

func (s *taskAnswerGuardRepoStub) ListForTaskAndStudent(context.Context, string, string) ([]domain.StudentTaskAnswer, error) {
	return nil, nil
}

func (s *taskAnswerGuardRepoStub) CountForTaskAndStudent(context.Context, string, string) (int, error) {
	return 0, nil
}

func (s *taskAnswerGuardRepoStub) ListForStudent(context.Context, string, int, int) ([]domain.StudentTaskAnswer, error) {
	return nil, nil
}

func (s *taskAnswerGuardRepoStub) CountForStudent(context.Context, string) (int, error) {
	return 0, nil
}

func (s *taskAnswerGuardRepoStub) GetProgressByTaskIDs(context.Context, string, []string) (map[string]domain.StudentTaskProgress, error) {
	return s.progress, nil
}

func lockedTaskGuardFixtures() (progressionTaskProviderStub, *taskAnswerGuardRepoStub, *ProgressionService) {
	provider := progressionTaskProviderStub{
		tasks: map[string]*TaskMetadata{
			"task-2": {
				ID:             "task-2",
				LessonID:       "lesson-2",
				CourseID:       "cv-1",
				Status:         domain.TaskStatusActive,
				Type:           1,
				SubmissionMode: taskSubmissionAnswerPayload,
				EvaluationMode: taskEvaluationAuto,
			},
		},
		structure: &CourseStructure{
			CourseID: "cv-1",
			Lessons: []CourseStructureLesson{
				{
					ID:     "lesson-1",
					Order:  1,
					Status: 1,
					Tasks: []CourseStructureTask{{
						ID: "task-1", LessonID: "lesson-1", CourseID: "cv-1", Order: 1, Status: 1, EvaluationMode: "AUTO",
					}},
				},
				{
					ID:     "lesson-2",
					Order:  2,
					Status: 1,
					Tasks: []CourseStructureTask{{
						ID: "task-2", LessonID: "lesson-2", CourseID: "cv-1", Order: 1, Status: 1, EvaluationMode: "AUTO",
					}},
				},
			},
		},
	}
	repo := &taskAnswerGuardRepoStub{
		answers: map[string]*domain.StudentTaskAnswer{
			"answer-2": {
				ID:        "answer-2",
				StudentID: "user-1",
				TaskID:    "task-2",
				Status:    domain.StudentTaskAnswerStatusInProgress,
			},
		},
		progress: map[string]domain.StudentTaskProgress{},
	}
	progression := &ProgressionService{TaskProvider: provider, Answers: repo}
	return provider, repo, progression
}

func TestSubmitTaskAnswerBlocksLockedTask(t *testing.T) {
	provider, repo, progression := lockedTaskGuardFixtures()
	uc := SubmitTaskAnswer{
		Answers:      repo,
		TaskProvider: provider,
		Progression:  progression,
	}

	_, err := uc.Handle(context.Background(), SubmitTaskAnswerInput{
		StudentID:           "user-1",
		TaskID:              "task-2",
		StudentTaskAnswerID: "answer-2",
		FilestorageID:       "file-1",
	})
	if err == nil {
		t.Fatalf("expected locked task error")
	}
	var lockedErr *TaskLockedError
	if !errors.As(err, &lockedErr) {
		t.Fatalf("expected TaskLockedError, got %T", err)
	}
	if lockedErr.RedirectTaskID != "task-1" {
		t.Fatalf("expected redirect to task-1, got %q", lockedErr.RedirectTaskID)
	}
	if repo.updated {
		t.Fatalf("expected locked submit to leave answer unchanged")
	}
}

func TestFinalValidationBlocksLockedTaskBeforeUpdatingAnswer(t *testing.T) {
	provider, repo, progression := lockedTaskGuardFixtures()
	uc := FinalValidation{
		Answers:      repo,
		TaskProvider: provider,
		Progression:  progression,
	}

	err := uc.Handle(context.Background(), "answer-2", json.RawMessage(`{"text":"done"}`))
	if err == nil {
		t.Fatalf("expected locked task error")
	}
	var lockedErr *TaskLockedError
	if !errors.As(err, &lockedErr) {
		t.Fatalf("expected TaskLockedError, got %T", err)
	}
	if repo.updated {
		t.Fatalf("expected locked final validation to leave answer unchanged")
	}
}
